_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for react-carplay DongleConfig on the Pi. These keys are merged into ~/.config/react-carplay/config.json by s52-apply-carplay-config.sh (run automatically by setup.sh). Edit a value here, then on the Pi run:  bash scripts/s52-apply-carplay-config.sh  — it applies and restarts CarPlay. Keys starting with _ are docs and are ignored.
_dpi: CarPlay UI/font scale reported to the phone. Higher = bigger text/icons/buttons. 165 = tiny on the 2.8in panel; 220 = comfortable. Bump toward 240-280 for larger, drop toward 190 for more on screen.
_resolution: width/height (px, portrait after rotation) sent to the phone. Lowering (e.g. 360x480) enlarges everything further at a slight sharpness cost; DPI is the cleaner first lever.
_wifiType: Phone link band. MUST match the dongle's wifi5GSwitch (1=5ghz). This dongle defaults to 5 GHz. See docs/carlinkit-dongle-reference.md.
_mediaDelay: Audio buffer in ms. Higher = fewer dropouts, more latency. 2000 is the tuned value for this build.
